title: Uniform torsion transfer through a double adic quotient diagram
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ a Noetherian algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space, def-sfb-space-coherent-adic-system], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use quasi-coherent modules on the small etale ringed site [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module, def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]; coherent means coherent on etale scheme charts [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], fix $\operatorname{Spec}A\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated of finite type [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. Let $J,K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be quasi-coherent ideals and $X_q^K\hookrightarrow X$ the closed subspace cut out by $K^q$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Proper support means a proper closed carrier [def-sfb-space-proper-quot-functor]. For every $q\geq1$ assume that $J$-completion on $X_q^K$ is an equivalence between coherent modules with proper support and coherent adic systems with proper support. Let $M\in\mathrm{Coh}(X,J)$, $N\in\mathrm{Coh}(X,K)$ and a coherent module $H$ all have proper support. Give maps $a:M\to\widehat H_J$, $d:N\to\widehat H_K$, and an isomorphism of double diagrams $\sigma_{e,n}:N_e/J^nN_e\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n/K^eM_n$ for $e,n\geq1$. Write $\theta_{e,n}:(H/K^eH)/J^n\xrightarrow{\sim}(H/J^nH)/K^e$ for quotient interchange induced by the quotient maps from $H$, and assume $(a_n\bmod K^e)\sigma_{e,n}=\theta_{e,n}(d_e\bmod J^n)$. If $t\geq1$ and $K^t$ kills every ordinary sheaf kernel and cokernel of $a_n$, then $K^{4t}$ kills the ordinary sheaf kernels and cokernels of all $d_e$. This asserts a bound for the supplied maps, not the existence of $N$, $d$, or an algebraization of $M$.

source.place: Tag 08BC (lemma-existence-tricky), the two omitted torsion-bound arguments K^(2t) and K^(4t), using Tag 08BA (remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by).

proof.text: Fix $e,n\geq1$ and an affine etale chart $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$. The chart calculus identifies the ordinary sheaf kernels, cokernels and quotients of $a_n$ with those of its $R$-module map. Put $L=K(U)$. Apply clause (c) of [lem-weil-pbc-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-mod-ideal] with annihilating ideal $L$, exponent $t$, and quotient ideal $L^e$. Thus $L^{2t}$ kills both errors of $a_n\bmod K^e$. Since this holds on every affine etale chart, $K^{2t}$ kills both ordinary sheaf errors of that reduced map. The exponent is independent of $e,n$.

source.place: Tag 08BC, lemma-existence-tricky, the two omitted torsion estimates; Tag 08BA, remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by. The faithful-completion argument below expands the second estimate.

proof.text: Write $u_{e,n}=d_e\bmod J^n$ and $v_{e,n}=a_n\bmod K^e$. The assumed square reads $v_{e,n}\sigma_{e,n}=\theta_{e,n}u_{e,n}$. Its two vertical maps are invertible and $\mathcal O_X$-linear. Consequently $\sigma_{e,n}$ restricts to an isomorphism of kernels, and $\theta_{e,n}$ induces an isomorphism of cokernels. Each isomorphism commutes with multiplication by local sections of $K^{2t}$. Step 1 therefore gives $K^{2t}\ker u_{e,n}=K^{2t}\operatorname{coker}u_{e,n}=0$ for all $e,n$.

source.place: Tag 08BC, lemma-existence-tricky, the two omitted torsion estimates; Tag 08BA, remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by. The faithful-completion argument below expands the second estimate.

proof.text: Fix $e$ and put $F=N_e$, $G=H/K^eH$, $u=d_e$, $P=\ker u$ and $Q=\operatorname{coker}u$. Both $F,G$ are coherent and killed by $K^e$. The adic transition identities give $F/KF\simeq N_1$: reduce each adjacent identity modulo $K$ and compose. On a geometric stalk where $N_1$ vanishes, $F=KF$ and hence $F=K^eF=0$. Conversely $N_1$ is a quotient of $F$. Thus $\operatorname{Supp}F=\operatorname{Supp}N_1$, which is proper by the hypothesis on $N$. The quotient $G$ has support contained in that of $H$. The chart calculus gives quasi-coherence of $P,Q$ and of the ideal-product submodules $B=K^{2t}P\subseteq F$ and $D=K^{2t}Q\subseteq Q$ (products are images of ideal-action tensor maps). Noetherian submodule and quotient closure gives their coherence. Their supports are closed subsets of the proper supports of $F$ or $G$. The proper-support closed-subset theorem and the proper-carrier criterion give proper closed carriers for $F,G,P,Q,B,D$. Here coherence implies finite type by the Noetherian coherence criterion. Every one of these modules is killed by $K^e$, since it is a subquotient of $F$ or $G$.

source.place: Tag 08BC, lemma-existence-tricky, the two omitted torsion estimates; Tag 08BA, remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by. The faithful-completion argument below expands the second estimate.

proof.text: Let $j:B\hookrightarrow F$ be the inclusion. At every level $n$, the class of $x\in P$ in $F/J^nF$ belongs to $\ker u_{e,n}$. Step 2 says that multiplying this class by any local section of $K^{2t}$ gives zero. Ideal products are locally sums of such products, so $j(B)\subseteq J^nF$. The induced map $B/J^nB\to F/J^nF$ is therefore zero. It follows from the componentwise definition of completion on arrows that $\widehat j_J=0$. This does not identify the termwise kernel with a kernel in the category of adic systems.

source.place: Tag 08BC, lemma-existence-tricky, the two omitted torsion estimates; Tag 08BA, remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by. The faithful-completion argument below expands the second estimate.

proof.text: Let $k:D\hookrightarrow Q$ be the inclusion. On each affine etale chart the ordinary quotient calculation gives $\operatorname{coker}u_{e,n}=G/(u(F)+J^nG)=Q/J^nQ$: both quotient maps send $g$ to its class, so these identifications also hold as sheaves. The cokernel bound of step 2 gives $K^{2t}Q\subseteq J^nQ$ for every $n$. Hence the induced map $D/J^nD\to Q/J^nQ$ is zero and $\widehat k_J=0$. This uses the explicit cokernel quotient, with no assertion that completion is termwise exact.

source.place: Tag 08BC, lemma-existence-tricky, the two omitted torsion estimates; Tag 08BA, remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by. The faithful-completion argument below expands the second estimate.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-closed-adic-dictionary] to $i:Z=X_e^K\hookrightarrow X$, whose ideal is $K^e$. It identifies coherent proper-support modules on $Z$ with those on $X$ killed by $K^e$, including their arrows, and identifies their completion diagrams naturally. Thus the hypothesis that $J\mathcal O_Z$-completion on $Z$ is an equivalence implies that $J$-completion is faithful on this full subcategory of modules on $X$. Step 3 places both inclusions $j:B\to F$ and $k:D\to Q$ in that subcategory. Steps 4 and 5 identify their completions with the completions of the zero arrows. Faithfulness therefore gives $j=k=0$. An inclusion equal to zero has zero source, so $B=D=0$. We have proved $K^{2t}P=K^{2t}Q=0$. Since $K^{4t}\subseteq K^{2t}$, this gives the claimed $K^{4t}$ bounds for the fixed $e$, and $e$ was arbitrary.
